data.one_liner: Reactive BLE plugin for Android and iOS that supports multiple devices
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to scan for devices, connect, read/write characteristics, subscribe to notifications, and negotiate MTU size. It exposes streams for device discovery and connection state updates.
use_when: Need to communicate with several BLE devices simultaneously
Require reactive streams for real‑time updates
Need to negotiate MTU or clear GATT cache
avoid_when: Only a single BLE device is needed and a simple callback style is sufficient
You prefer a fully declarative UI framework for BLE
strengths: Cross‑platform (Android & iOS) with native permission handling
Built‑in MTU negotiation and GATT cache clearing
weaknesses: Requires native permission configuration in AndroidManifest and Info.plist
Setup involves platform‑specific steps (ProGuard, iOS plist entries)
data.setup_notes: Add BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, and location permissions to AndroidManifest.xml; add NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription or NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription to Info.plist; optionally add ProGuard rules for Android.
